chapter.heading: Praising the Lord in His House at NightA Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
Behold, bless
the Lord,All you servants of the Lord,Who by night stand in the house of the Lord!

Lift up
your hands in the sanctuary,And bless the Lord.

The Lord
who made heaven and earthBless you from Zion!
